set.body:
Track (not a single deliverable): build the bells-and-whistles variational layer incrementally, one family at a time, each with its solver lowering and a parity fixture. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §6.3–§6.5 and §9 laws 18–22. Split into per-family child beads as each is picked up.

Five distinct first-class concepts, never collapsed into one "transformation": typed maps (LinearMap/AffineMap/SmoothMap/GeneralMap capability hierarchy), parameterizations (free var → semantic θ, domain-reducing), operator policies (upstream statistical-estimate changes), functionals (soft preferences, own their prox), feasible sets (hard feasibility, own their projection). The single reusable mechanism: penalize(target = T(θ), functional = φ, weight) and constrain(target = T(θ), to = C) — a functional or feasible set pulled back through a typed target expression.

Build order (doc §10 Phase 5):
1. Quadratic pullbacks — ridge, graph smoothness. Exact rewrite ‖Tθ‖²_G ↦ ⟨θ, T★GT θ⟩, absorb into an eigen/normalization operator; carry equivalence evidence.
2. Separable prox — ℓ₁, group ℓ₂,₁ on explicit coordinates via a chart J.
3. Parameterizations — known support (W = E_S z), fixed rank (B = U V*), null-space elimination.
4. Split / ADMM families — fused lasso / total variation, overlapping groups (lift with auxiliary z = Tθ).
5. Operator policies — Ledoit–Wolf covariance shrinkage, joint-block CCA shrinkage (preserve block-adjoint, gauge, joint-PSD evidence).

Guards (laws 18–22): no coordinate property without a chart; no quadratic norm without geometry; a simple prox_φ does NOT imply a simple prox_{φ∘T} — split, never misapply; penalize vs constrain stay distinct at the public surface; operator shrinkage ≠ parameter ridge; no orphan traits (a capability ships only with a lowering that consumes it); every family parity-anchored (PMA/sparcl, glmnet, RGCCA, fused-lasso) and the fit reports its achieved guarantee (globally-certified … stationary … heuristic). Data-driven selection (α, learned charts/graphs/alignment) belongs to ModelSpec, refit inside training folds — deferred until a family needs it.

Acceptance is per family: term type + solver lowering + JVM+JS tests + parity fixture vs the reference implementation.
set.title: Multivar: the variational term layer (penalties/constraints/policies/parameterizations), built family-by-family
